name: regex_builder
description: Build a regex pattern from a plain-language description, test a pattern against a string, explain what a pattern does, extract all matches from text, replace matches in text, or validate a pattern's correctness/efficiency.

action.description: build: generate a pattern from a description. test: check if a pattern matches a string. explain: describe what an existing pattern does. extract: find all matches in text. replace: substitute matches in text. validate: check correctness/efficiency of a pattern.

description.description: Plain-language description of what to match. Required for action='build'.

pattern.description: A regex pattern. Required for test, explain, extract, replace, validate.

test_string.description: String to test the pattern against. Required for action='test'.

text.description: Text to extract from or replace within. Required for extract and replace.
